lastCompletedStory.title: Coverage ratchet (up-only, lowering requires tracker ref in diff)

nextStoryContext: Coverage ratchet gate live. Runs `bun test --coverage`, parses 'All files' row (columns: % Funcs | % Lines), compares against floors in scripts/coverage-budget.json. DI pattern: getCoverage() and getStagedDiff() injected in tests. Floor-lowering check mirrors file-size ratchet: parseDiffKv extracts numeric values from staged diff; findLoweredFloors detects decreases; requires CAM-\d+|#\d+|https?:// in diff when lowering. Gate added as index 6 ('coverage') in GATES manifest, before ci-parity. Budget floors: functions=75.65, lines=78.63 (measured after story code added). 23 new tests. check-all.test.ts updated to expect 8 gates. Note: bun test runs twice in check:all (once for 'test' gate, once for 'coverage' gate). Key gotcha: parseCoverageOutput targets the 'All files' row only; file-level rows ignored. spawnSync default stdio is 'pipe', both r.stdout and r.stderr captured.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: --coverage flag uses text reporter by default, output columns are '% Funcs | % Lines' with an 'All files' aggregate row. Implementation matches.
